description: Quantitative TM-score fold assignment for ATOSA modules with disordered-region negative control
code:
import requests, json, time, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
full=open("atosa_af_full.pdb").read()
def frag(a,b): return "\n".join(l for l in full.split("\n") if l.startswith("ATOM") and a<=int(l[22:26])<=b)+"\nEND\n"
def foldseek(txt,mode="tmalign"):
    tid=requests.post("https://search.foldseek.com/api/ticket",files={"q":("q.pdb",txt)},
        data=[("mode",mode),("database[]","pdb100")],timeout=300).json()["id"]
    for _ in range(100):
        s=requests.get(f"https://search.foldseek.com/api/ticket/{tid}",timeout=120).json()
        if s.get("status") in ("COMPLETE","ERROR"): break
        time.sleep(5)
    if s.get("status")!="COMPLETE": return []
    r=requests.get(f"https://search.foldseek.com/api/result/{tid}/0",timeout=300).json()
    al=r["results"][0]["alignments"]
    return al[0] if al and isinstance(al[0],list) else al

PDBNAME={"5xuy":"ATG13 HORMA:ATG101","8do8":"ATG13:ATG101 + ATG9","5xv1":"ATG13 HORMA:ATG101",
         "4yk8":"S. pombe Mad2","5xv4":"ATG13 HORMA:ATG101","4aez":"S. pombe Mad2","2qyf":"MAD2/p31comet",
         "3gmh":"MAD2 dimer","5khu":"MAD2 (model)","2vfx":"MAD2 dimer","6ww9":"REV7/MAD2L2-SHLD3","1klq":"MAD2"}
rows=[]
for lab,(a,b),kind in [("1-230\n(ordered N-term)",(1,230),"ordered"),
                       ("300-530\n(disordered control)",(300,530),"control"),
                       ("870-1000\n(DUF4210/Atos)",(870,1000),"ordered")]:
    txt=frag(a,b)
    pl=np.array([float(l[60:66]) for l in txt.split("\n") if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"])
    hits=foldseek(txt)
    for h in hits[:10]:
        pid=h["target"].split("-")[0]
        rows.append(dict(fragment=lab,kind=kind,meanpLDDT=round(pl.mean(),1),pdb=pid,
                         annot=PDBNAME.get(pid,""),tm=float(h["eval"]),alnLen=h["alnLength"],seqId=h["seqId"]))
    if not hits: rows.append(dict(fragment=lab,kind=kind,meanpLDDT=round(pl.mean(),1),pdb="none",annot="no hit",tm=0.0,alnLen=0,seqId=0))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); df.to_csv("foldseek_tmalign_atosa.csv",index=False)
print(df.to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,5.2))
order=df.fragment.unique(); xs=[]; cols=[]; labs=[]; vals=[]
pal={"1-230\n(ordered N-term)":"#c0392b","870-1000\n(DUF4210/Atos)":"#16a085","300-530\n(disordered control)":"#95a5a6"}
pos=0
for f in order:
    sub=df[df.fragment==f].head(8)
    for _,r in sub.iterrows():
        xs.append(pos); vals.append(r.tm); cols.append(pal[f])
        labs.append(f"{r.pdb.upper()} {r.annot}" if r.annot else r.pdb.upper()); pos+=1
    pos+=1.4
ax.bar(xs,vals,color=cols,width=0.85)
ax.axhline(0.5,color="#2c3e50",ls="--",lw=1.2)
ax.text(max(xs)*0.78,0.52,"TM-score 0.5 = same fold",fontsize=9,color="#2c3e50")
ax.set_xticks(xs); ax.set_xticklabels(labs,rotation=55,ha="right",fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_ylabel("Foldseek TM-align TM-score vs PDB100"); ax.set_ylim(0,0.8)
hs=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=pal[f]) for f in order]
ax.legend(hs,[f.replace("\n"," ") for f in order],fontsize=8.5,frameon=False,loc="upper right")
ax.set_title("ATOSA (Q32MH5) structural fold assignment by Foldseek TM-align\n"
             "Residues 1-230 match HORMA domains at TM 0.62-0.67; the DUF4210 module and the disordered control do not match any known fold",fontsize=10.5)
ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
